decisions.reason: As a wood-floor cleaner it is commercially complementary to the firm's flooring knowledge and customer base, even though the chemical formulation is somewhat outside its core manufacturing expertise.
A maintenance oil for wooden floors fits closely with the firm's existing know-how in wood surfaces and gives it good scope to learn and improve through customer feedback.
A care product for oiled wood floors is strongly related to the firm's installed base of wood-floor products, so its existing knowledge should help it refine and market the product.
A floor underlay with moisture protection is adjacent to flooring installation and therefore sufficiently related to the firm's business to justify continued learning and commercialization.

High-density underlay foam is the least connected to the firm's traditional wood-processing capabilities, but it still supports the flooring system and is worth keeping while the firm builds knowledge.
An oak parquet floor sits squarely in the firm's core knowledge base in wood products, making it the product with the strongest absorptive-capacity advantage and the lowest likelihood of withdrawal.
